newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia's Podravka forges ahead to 256 kuna.
newsitem.headline: Croatia's Podravka forges ahead to 256 kuna.

text.p: Shares in food processor Podravka forged ahead to 256 kuna in otherwise slow trade on Friday on the Zagreb Stock Exchange, traders said.
"Podravka has really livened up, its price is still rising," said one trader with a large foreign client base.
By 1020 GMT Podravka had risen six kuna from Thursday's close and sold some 2,000 shares.
"This is a large volume for this time of day," the trader added. Most transactions are normally done between 1100 and 1200 GMT, the last hour of the session.
Podravka reversed its downward trend on Thursday, a day after it closed a deal for a 60 million German mark loan at 2.50 percent over Libor, which will be used for repaying old debts at higher rates.
Closing prices on the Zagreb Stock Exchange are available on page ZAGSTOCK each afternoon from Tuesday to Friday.
